name: Hornero Dual Clock
description: Dual Clock 2.0: local time next to a second zone (UTC by default, as in 1.x) in the bar, with a details popover. Pure-JS rule-based offsets, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Time and Agenda 2.0: shared Time facade instead of an own timer, Theme tokens, keyboard-operable indicator with a details popover (locale dates, applied offsets, DST state, offset difference), selectable second zone defaulting to UTC with the identical 1.x label, typed settings and Argentine Spanish catalog.
Local time next to UTC in the bar for coordinating across time zones; themed text and vertical two-line layout.

secondZone.description: Zone shown on the second line (UTC in 1.x). Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

showSeconds.description: Show seconds on both lines (1.x showed HH:mm only).

twentyFourHour.description: Use 24-hour times (the 1.x behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.
